01

About

A Canadian company connecting Canadian projects with world-class manufacturing and EPC capability.

Rongyi Global Inc. is a Canadian company headquartered in Westmount, Montréal. We connect Canadian corporations, utilities, developers and governments with Tier-1 global manufacturing and engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) capability, and we structure cooperation in new energy and advanced manufacturing.

We work with international manufacturing partners through a global supply network, bringing proven technology and production capacity to projects across Canada.

02

Focus areas

01

Utility-scale & C&I energy storage

Battery energy storage systems for utilities, independent power producers, and large commercial and industrial sites.

02

Solar-plus-storage

Solar generation paired with storage to firm up renewable output and add dispatchable capacity to the grid.

03

Data centre energy infrastructure

Dedicated power supply, energy storage and backup infrastructure for data centre developments.

04

Grid & electrical equipment

Transformers, switchgear and related electrical equipment for grid modernization and industrial electrification.

05

Industrial project development

Development of industrial projects in Canada, including local manufacturing and assembly capacity.

06

Residential energy storage

Home battery systems for backup power, solar self-consumption and lower electricity bills, supplied and supported across Canada.

07

Modular & prefabricated buildings

Rapid-deployment prefabricated buildings and equipment cabins for AI data centres, energy facilities and housing — including green-energy generation buildings.

08

Wind energy

Onshore and offshore wind power — equipment supply and project cooperation for wind farms and related grid connection.

09

Power cables & materials

High-, medium- and low-voltage power cables and electrical materials for power grids, data centres and industrial projects.

03

How we work

Joint ventures

Partnership structures that align long-term interests between Canadian and manufacturing partners.

Local manufacturing & assembly in Canada

Building production capacity in Canada, close to the projects and customers it serves.

Supplier registration & due-diligence support

Support with supplier registration, pre-qualification and due-diligence processes for Canadian buyers and project owners.

One Canadian point of contact, operating under Canadian law.
